errors.generic: The request could not be processed. Try again shortly.
errors.conflict: Someone else changed it first. The latest state was reloaded.
errors.precondition: This request needs a concurrency header. Reload the latest state and try again.
errors.inProgress: The same operation is already in progress. Check its state instead of creating a new one.
errors.emergencyStop: Submission is blocked while emergency stop is active.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.notFound: The resource was not found or is not accessible.
errors.providerBlocked: Blocked — the provider policy does not allow this.
errors.agentGrantForbidden: Agents cannot be granted send or approve permissions.

members.title: Members
members.description: Manage members, roles, agent principals, and invitations.
members.disableDescription: Disabling is accepted as a job (202) together with a reassignment / pending-work policy.
members.emptyDescription: Add members with an admin-issued invite link.
members.inviteCreatedDescription: This link is shown only once. It cannot be viewed again after you share it.
members.inviteMissingLink: The response contained no invite link. Check the invitation list for status.

invitation.emptyDescription: Invitation status appears here once a link is created.

agents.emptyDescription: Create an agent principal and issue service credentials.

credentials.createdDescription: This secret is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe.
credentials.revokeDescription: Auth is rejected immediately, and pending work requested by this credential is stopped (default).

mailAccounts.title: Mail accounts
mailAccounts.description: Shared mailbox connections and per-mailbox grants.
mailAccounts.oauthNotice: OAuth secrets are never stored or displayed. Only connection state is shown.
mailAccounts.connectDescription: You are issued a provider auth URL to visit. Secrets are never displayed.
mailAccounts.reconnectDone: Reauth started. Check the connection status.
mailAccounts.emptyDescription: Connect a mailbox to grant read, compose, send, approve, and assign permissions.

grants.title: Mailbox grants
grants.rulesNotice: Grants apply as an intersection with role permissions. A child permission cannot be on without its parent.
grants.blockAgent: Agents cannot hold send or approve permissions
grants.blockRole: Approve can only be granted to Admin or Manager

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: Per-host calendar connections and sync state.
calendars.privacyNotice: Private event details are never shown. Only connection metadata is visible.
calendars.emptyDescription: Connect a calendar to offer public booking slots.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage your sessions, password, and security records.

sessions.title: Your sessions
sessions.revokeDescription: This session's authentication is rejected immediately.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Read-only view of send-basis, channel policy, and emergency-stop state.
policies.consentNotice: This screen is read-only. A UI checkbox is not evidence of a send basis or consent; changes are made in each area of Operations and Settings by users with permission.

emergency.on: Emergency stop active — new external submissions are blocked
emergency.description: Emergency stop blocks all new external submissions (sends, booking confirmations, etc.) immediately.

channels.title: Delivery channel policy
channels.emptyDescription: Only channels whose policy review is 'allowed' can be enabled.

accounts.title: Connection state
accounts.emptyDescription: Connections needing reauth appear here with a warning state.
